author: Cleep
changelog:
## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-06

### Added
- Add LSM6DSOX motion controls module for Raspberry Pi over I2C
- Detect right, left, front, and back rotations from filtered tilt angle
- Detect right side, left side, and top taps from acceleration impulses
- Emit motioncontrols.rotation.detected, motioncontrols.tap.detected, and motioncontrols.status.changed events
- Add configurable thresholds, cooldowns, and setup notes for noise tuning
label: Motion controls
longdescription: Detects right, left, front, and back rotations plus right side, left side, and top taps using an LSM6DSOX accelerometer/gyroscope breakout over I2C. This is intended for local device controls such as fast-forward on right rotation, next track on right tap, previous track on left tap, and pause/play on top tap.
